# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(xgboost)
  library(dplyr)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, ".."), mustWork = FALSE)

OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
XGB_DIR    <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "xgBoost_outputs")
MODEL_DIR  <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "models")
PRED_DIR   <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictions")

run_name <- "xgBoost_aggregated_imputed"

data_file      <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "data_aggregated_imputed.tsv")
training_file  <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", "eqtl_files", "training_data_snppg_aggregated.tsv.gz")
predictor_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictors_aggregated.txt")

model_dir <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, run_name)
pred_dir  <- file.path(PRED_DIR,  run_name)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(pred_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

feat_out <- file.path(model_dir, "feature_names.txt")
outfile  <- file.path(pred_dir, paste0(run_name, ".tsv"))

plot_path <- file.path(dirname(outfile), "cv_curves_combined.png")
evaluationlog_path <- file.path(dirname(outfile), "evaluationlog.rds")
```

# 2. Preparation
```{r}
full_data <- fread(data_file)
training_data <- fread(training_file)
```

# 3.
```{r}
ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",     # fuse IN  → Neurons
  Ext = "Neurons",     # fuse Ext → Neurons
  End = "Endothelial"
)

remap_ct <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(ct_map), ct_map[x], x)

training_data[, celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]
full_data[,     celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]

# Merge on full identity
#index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "snp", "chr")
index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype")
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# Labels: 1 = pos, 2 = strong neg -> make 0/1
data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L, 1L)]

cat(sprintf("Number of training instances: %s\n", nrow(data)))
cat(sprintf("Number of positives: %s\n", sum(data$label == 1L)))
cat(sprintf("Number of negatives: %s\n\n", sum(data$label == 0L)))

# Predictors
predictors <- scan(predictor_file, what = character(), quiet = TRUE)
#predictors <- c("closest_tss", "cicero", "scent", "signac")
pred_cols  <- intersect(predictors, names(data))

writeLines(pred_cols, feat_out)
cat(sprintf("Saved feature names (%d) to %s\n",
            length(pred_cols), feat_out))

stopifnot(length(pred_cols) > 0)
cat(sprintf("Using %d features for model training and prediction.\n\n", length(pred_cols)))

# Feature matrix + labels
annotation_feature_tabb <- data[, pred_cols, with = FALSE]
labels <- data$label

```


# 4. Run
```{r}
celltypes <- sort(unique(data$celltype))
predictions <- data.frame()
cv_curves <- list()
best_rounds <- list()
evaluation <- data.table()

# --- Loop over CTs (LOCTO) ---
for (ct in celltypes) {
  cat(sprintf("\nHeld-out cell type: %s\n", ct))
  
  test_idx  <- data$celltype == ct
  train_idx <- !test_idx
  
  X_train <- as.matrix(annotation_feature_tabb[train_idx, ..pred_cols])
  y_train <- labels[train_idx]
  X_test  <- as.matrix(annotation_feature_tabb[test_idx, ..pred_cols])
  
  # CV folds by chromosome
  chrs_train <- data$chr[train_idx]
  folds <- split(seq_along(chrs_train), chrs_train)
  
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train)
  
  # --- Cross-validation to find best nrounds ---
  cv <- xgb.cv(
    data = dtrain,
    folds = folds,
    max_depth        = 6,
    eta              = 0.05,
    gamma            = 10,
    min_child_weight = 6,
    subsample        = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 1.0,
    nrounds          = 500,
    nthread          = 8,
    objective        = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric      = "aucpr",
    verbose          = 0,
    early_stopping_rounds = 5
  )
  
  best_nrounds <- cv$best_iteration
  best_rounds[[ct]] <- best_nrounds
  cat(sprintf("Best nrounds: %d\n", best_nrounds))
  
  # --- Train final model with best nrounds ---
  bst <- xgboost(
    data             = dtrain,
    max_depth        = 6,
    eta              = 0.05,
    gamma            = 10,
    min_child_weight = 6,
    subsample        = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 1.0,
    nrounds          = best_nrounds,
    nthread          = 8,
    objective        = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric      = "aucpr",
    verbose          = 0
  )
  
  # Save model
  safe_ct <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct)
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("xgboost_%s.model", safe_ct))
  xgb.save(bst, model_path)
  
  # --- Predict on held-out CT ---
  p_hat <- predict(bst, X_test)
  fold_pred <- cbind(
    as.data.frame(data[test_idx, ..index_cols]),
    xgBoost_probability = p_hat
  )
  predictions <- rbind(predictions, fold_pred)
  cat(sprintf("Scored links: %d\n", nrow(fold_pred)))
  
  # --- Store CV curves ---
  e <- cv$evaluation_log
  e$celltype <- ct
  cv_curves[[ct]] <- e
  evaluation <- rbind(evaluation, e, fill = TRUE)

}

# Collect all predictions at the end
fwrite(predictions, outfile, sep="\t")
cat(sprintf("Saved predictions to %s\n", outfile))

# Combine CV logs
cv_dt <- rbindlist(cv_curves)

# --- Combined plot ---
p <- ggplot(cv_dt, aes(x = iter, y = test_aucpr_mean, color = celltype, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_line(size=0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = test_aucpr_mean - test_aucpr_std,
                  ymax = test_aucpr_mean + test_aucpr_std),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  labs(x = "Boosting round", y = "Test AUPR",
       title = "Cross-validation AUPR by cell type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(plot_path, p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
saveRDS(evaluation, evaluationlog_path)
cat(sprintf("Saved combined CV curve plot to %s\n", plot_path))

```
